profile.headline: Software Engineer at Stripe
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with extensive experience in both full-stack and backend development of
highly-scalable distributed systems.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned end-to-end development of Customer Balances, Gift Cards, and Loyalty products. 

New greenfield (0 to 1) payment method (Customer Balances), including first-party product (House Accounts), API, mobile, and POS integration.

Strong mentorship experience, including participation in Upskill and Elevate programs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical development of compliance portal to submit privacy requests and orchestrate
response of different internal products. Kotlin, React, Kafka, MongoDB, Redis, PCF, CI/CD

Developed platform to unify internal products via APIs and events. Kotlin, Java, Kafka, Spring,
MongoDB, Redis CI/CD

Implemented numerous features related to employee onboarding, including initiative to develop e-signature and forms-builder platform, employment eligibility and tax forms, and  globalization. C#, RabbitMQ, MongoDB

Enhanced and optimized critical areas of data access layer of DSL-based platform. C#, MongoDB

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented set of utilities to help technician diagnose cytometer. C/C++, C#

Developed real-time low-level embedded C/C++ code for a Flow Cytometer firmware. VxWorks

Worked on imaging and analysis software to process, analyze, and plot data points gathered by
cytometer. C#, C/C++, MFC, SQL Server

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description: Designed custom client solutions for the time-sharing and hospitality industry. VB .NET, VB 6, SQL Server

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Created wizard to diagnose network problems by gathering and analyzing TCP/IP. Java, AUIML, CL, XML

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Prototyping and developing POC for researchers 

Developed system for communication of heterogeneous devices for hands-free communication by surgeons. Java, Voice+XHTML, XML, SIP, ASP .NET (C#)

Project was featured in ABC's Miracle Worker in March 2006.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Developed C# tool used by multiple Biztalk teams to take, store, and compare screenshots of the entire
scrollable area of any section of IE. C#, SQL, Active Accessibility, W32 API, MSHTML

positions.title: Co-Op
positions.description: Created a suite of XML-defined tools for API unit and regression testing, a workload generation utility based on a DSL to stress the multithreaded subsystem of OS/400. Java
